content.title: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway bets on Alphabet
content.description:
Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B, BRK-A) revealed it has taken a stake in Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL). The position is currently valued at just over $4 billion. The news came on the same day Google announced it was going to spend about $40 billion on AI data centers in Texas.

content.title: Does Meta, Google's use of debt to finance AI signal a bubble?
content.description:
Meta (META), Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), and Oracle (ORCL) are among the companies funding artificial intelligence (AI) spending through corporate bond sales.

Robinhood chief investment officer Stephanie Guild, Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Ines Ferré, and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma examine whether the trend signals the existence of an AI bubble.

content.title: Disney and YouTube TV Agree to Multi-Year Deal, Ending Two-Week Blackout
content.summary: With another weekend of sports arriving, YouTube TV and Walt  Disney  agreed late Friday to end their carriage dispute, returning ESPN and other Disney channels to YouTube TV’s 10 million subscribers.  Disney said it had reached a multi-year distribution agreement with the  Alphabet  -owned unit.  “As part of the new deal, Disney’s full suite of networks and stations – including ESPN and ABC – have already begun to be restored to YouTube TV subscribers,” Disney said late Friday.

content.title: Berkshire Added $4 Billion Alphabet Stake and Further Pared Apple Stock
content.summary: Warren Buffett’s conglomerate was a net seller of stocks during the third quarter, but it did add a position in Google’s parent company.

content.title: Berkshire Hathaway Bought Alphabet Shares in the Third Quarter. Here’s What It Sold.
content.summary: The filing, released on Friday, detailed the firm’s equity holdings of U.S.-listed securities as of Sept. 30.  Alphabet made up 1.6% of Berkshire’s portfolio by the end of September.  In the third quarter, Berkshire sold $10.6 billion worth of  Apple  shares, $1.9 billion worth of  Bank of America  stock, and $1.2 billion worth of holdings of  VeriSign  a provider of domain registry services, the report showed.

content.title: Berkshire Hathaway reveals $4.3 billion stake in Alphabet, cuts Apple
content.summary: Investing.com -- Berkshire Hathaway disclosed a $4.3 billion stake in Google’s parent Alphabet, making the company its 10th largest equity holding as of September 30, according to a regulatory filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday.

content.title: Google to invest $40 billion in Texas data centers through 2027, Bloomberg reports
content.summary: Investing.com -- Google plans to invest $40 billion to build three new data centers in Texas by 2027, Bloomberg reported Friday, expanding its infrastructure as AI competition intensifies.
